R55, R2–R4: projectlist and projectquestions are reads of admin, member and probe, viewer stamped, NEEDS null, in project-roster's and basis-versions' families; drawquestion is cite's — its classes, contribute, in EDGE_ACTIONS and POSITIONAL_ACTS beside cite; projectbarset is strengthbar's stamps (DECLARATION_ACTIONS) for a member session only, contribute; monitorset is addressfrequencyset's stamps (MONITORING_ACTIONS) for a member session only, contribute — each in both session sets, the act gate session (negative control: a drifted spec or list is seen)

R55, R6: projectlist is served by project-roster's map with the viewer read from the query; heldcaptures (capture R88, the new state field) and capturerequest (capture-requests R56) keep their specs and are served by their owners' maps (negative control: a key the owner does not read does not reach)

R56 (N980): sourceof and sourcerung are in SESSION_OPS.member and SESSION_OPS.admin, their specs unchanged — reads of admin, member and probe, viewer stamped, a present null — served by sources' map with the viewer from the query; an ai credential is no class of theirs (R2), and sourcereadlog stays out of the sets (negative control)

R57 (K3084; credentials R65, R66, R69, R71): unlock and reauth a session's own, mutating, NEEDS null, stamped session, source and country, in both sets; passwordresetlink an administrator's act, by stamped, NEEDS null; passwordresetlook and passwordreset public (in no session set), stamped source and country, a present null NEEDS row (K3147) — each in credentials' family and served by its map, the password and the link read from the body only (negative control: signout's stamps carry no source, and a query password does not reach)

R58, R62, R63 (K3061 D3, K3143, K3144; credentials R66): REAUTH_ACTS is frozen data, op → null or {field, values}, naming exactly the acts that ask the password again — caseratify, publishat, publishatmove, ratify, docketpost; adminendorse, adminremove, memberset (its role field present at all, values null, R62), memberadd (role admin); subscriptionsignin (step start), accountreferenceset, groupkeyset, projectkeyset, projectsigninset — each a declared mutating op, with its argument where one makes it so; exported by index.mjs (negative control: an act not named, signout, is absent)

R59 (DEC-205, DEC-207 (8), N1001): grouplogoset and grouplanguagesset administrators' acts in instance-setup's family, by stamped, NEEDS null; grouplanguages a public read, in no session set, a present null NEEDS row (K3147); signrequest a member's act in tasks' family, by and viewer stamped, contribute, machineClasses []; signintrace a session's read in signin-door's family, viewer stamped; R34: each member op is named in ACT_HELP_ABSENT or explained, never both; signrequest served by tasks' map (negative control: a drifted spec is seen)

R55, R57, R59, R61, R5, R7: t47.mjs is frozen data — each share names an owner whose family exists, each family an owner no other names, every kind one of OP_KINDS, and each family op merged into OP_FAMILIES (negative control: a kind outside OP_KINDS is seen)

R61 (K3104; people R37): peopledirectory a member session's read in people's family, viewer stamped, NEEDS null, both session sets; served by people's map, its q, show, office, namedIn, since, cursor and limit and the viewer read from the query; named in ACT_HELP_ABSENT as a read a screen draws from while ACT_HELP holds no text for it (negative control: a body viewer does not reach)

R54, R60 (K3062; DEC-198–DEC-217): R21 read against the registry at PR #33's head — every function act an op or an alias, the one new since PR #28 (subscriptiondisconnect) a declared op by its own name, capture no act of the capture screen, which names captureupload; every declared act has a spec; the one owed act, owed:passwordresetlink DEC-201, is declared under its own name by R57; projectaikeepaway and every act once owed (itemtakeup, actionscope, filingsecondapprove, escalationstoppursuing, infolevelset, subscriptionsignin) are declared acts; the owed acts of wizard-scripts R35 (passwordreset, grouplanguagesset, grouplogoset, signrequest) are served under their names; hostingaccessset is the act on setup and group, hostingaccess none (negative control: an undeclared act is seen)

tests: R76 (T51; DEC-330 owed; U348; K3810): BROWSER_ACTS names the seven acts DEC-330 draws that are done in the browser alone, each {screen, census, registry} with the registry row it takes the place of (`owed:<act> DEC-330`), frozen, on the screen and census line DEC-330 gives it, and each is exactly one owed row of the screen registry (negative control: a name the table does not hold is not a browser act)

R76: a browser act is not an op — no spec in OPS, no row in NEEDS, no place in either session set, ACT_GATE (the gate answers it as it answers any name no table holds), REAUTH_ACTS, an act list, a family, the alias table, OP_STAMPS or UNATTENDED_BY_DECISION, no stamp, and it is on none of ACT_HELP_ABSENT's grounds (R34's partition runs over ops only) (negative control: a spec added for hashcopy fails the test)

R76, R21: the totality — every act the registry marks owed is exactly one of (a) read as served (an op declared under its name), (b) a browser act whose `registry` string equals the row's `owed:<act> DEC-330`, or (c) still owed, named: the registry's owed acts split with nothing in two classes and nothing left over (negative control: an owed act in no class is seen)

R76: wizard-scripts registers an owed act only when an op is declared under its name, so a browser act stays unregistered and a wizard step naming one is refused as naming no op (op=wizardcheck), while a declared op passes (negative control: a step naming an op the registry offers is accepted)

R77, R78, R79 (T51): the 14 session reads are declared once each, in their owners' families with the kinds R77 to R79 give them, the spec and the present null NEEDS row of the kind, both session sets, the stamps named, in no act list, no bearer fence, off AI_GRANT_OPS and never unattended, with an owner line in t51.mjs (negative control: an op with no owner line fails)

R77, R78, R79: the kinds' controls — an `ai` credential is refused every op (it is in none of its classes or machine classes), the ops R78 and R79 name (holdsdue, templatebyhandle, rulefields, clocksrunning) refuse every bearer (a caller arriving without a member's session is refused: machineClasses []), and adminremovalsopen is a session's alone (negative control: a bearer-admitting read admits a bearer)

R77, R78, R79, R4: each viewer, each `by` and each request field of the 12 ops an owner's map serves reaches the owner at the site it reads (the query), and a body copy does not, nor does another key (negative control per op); the two no owner map serves (approvedunsent and checkpointsdue) are the control plane's route (screens-action R30, control-plane R110)

R77 (K3853): publishedfrozen is public — classes null, not mutating, no credential, nothing stamped, no NEEDS capability (a present null row), in neither session set, id a query field read by public-read's own map, in public-read's family, off AI_GRANT_OPS and no act list — and answered with no credential (negative control: a credential-gated read is not public)

R77 (K3843, K3872): projectlist's `after` and the `scope` parameter of searchfields, search and meaningrows are request fields the door passes as given — their specs are unchanged and nothing is added for them: no new op, no stamp (negative control: a stamp key is not a request field)

R78 (N858, N1046; DEC-340, U366, K3935): over the registry (77 screens at 8c5e692e19 or later) every act the screens `hold`, `holdnotice`, `counsel` and `grouprules` list is a declared op under its lowercased name, actionhold is no longer listed on `action` and procedureguides is, and holdsdue's `holdsOf` form, templatesforaction's `unofferedFor` and the reads' fields ride ops already declared (negative control: an undeclared name fails)

R79 (T51; N1088, K4059; action-clocks R24): clocksrunning is a read in action-clocks' family — classes admin, member, probe, machineClasses [], not mutating, viewer stamped, NEEDS null, in both session sets — and the owner serves it from the query's viewer (negative control: a caller arriving without a member's session is refused, a bearer is not admitted)

R77 (K3826, K3852): heldat's `by` is the session's member alone — stamped by the door from the session, never taken from a caller (a body or query copy is overwritten by the stamp), absent when the caller arrives without a session, so `check: true` from an admin, probe or ai credential carries no member and capture refuses it MEMBER_SESSION_REQUIRED (its R86 fence); declared a read, its one write the governor's bookkeeping (negative control: bundlehistory carries no by)

R82 (T51 fix round; K4227; screens-investigate R51; amends R18): standardinforce, standards' in-force read, is in SESSION_OPS.member and SESSION_OPS.admin, so the shell's act gate answers session for it and draws its button — its spec, stamps and NEEDS row are the ones standards declares (admin, member, probe; not mutating; viewer; null), it is explained or named under the read ground (R34), and an `ai` credential is no class of it (negative control: standard and standards, its siblings, stay out of the session sets; an op in no set answers machine)

R83 (T51 fix round; K4237; screens-settings C30): export, the copy of the group's records, is in SESSION_OPS.admin — the founder's session — and in no other set, so the founder's session can take a copy and the shell's act gate answers admin-session for it; its spec (classes admin, mutating) and NEEDS row are unchanged, and it is in no member set (negative control: a member session's set lacks it, the gate answers admin-session, never session; its siblings exportlog and exportpage stay out of the admin set; an `ai` credential is no class of it)

R19, R2, R3, R4, R34 (T51 fix round 6, G55; K4208): moneyingestread is calculations' read beside moneyingest — in calculations' family as a read, so its spec, NEEDS row, session sets and viewer stamp are those of calculations' other reads (table), its request fields ingest, kind, after and limit are no stamp, it is named under the read ground alone, and moneyingest stays a member's act with its spec, row and ground (negative control: the act is not a read and the read is not mutating)

R22, R5, R6 (T51; K5232; action-holds R22, R5, R6; screens-action R32): holdsplaced is a session read in action-holds' family — the sessionread spec, a present null NEEDS row, both session sets, viewer stamped, no bearer admitted, off AI_GRANT_OPS and never unattended, served by action-holds' ops map — and actionholdpreview and actionholdrelease accept `from` in their declared fields, holdsplaced's fields being `after` and `limit` alone (negative control: an op its owner declares no fields for answers undefined)

R64 B29 (seam, control-plane): the alarm runs a pending render with the `deliver` the assembly is handed (control-plane's `deliverOwedRender` in the class), and the delivery reaches it with the answer and the session
